download [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-46#post-3356278]BFAV unofii﻿cial[/url]﻿

drop files on mods folder

OLD VERSION:

[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]BFAV[/url]﻿

[*]Download This mod and unzip in the mods folder
[*]Choose the pokemon you want by tag inside a Content.json in Entries, Example: Dragonite or Latias or Alola Vulpix
[*]Now Open BFAV/config.json selects where will be selling (chicken, cow, and other, but remember its only the market, the prize and the product will be different for each pokemon.
[/list]
